Ground3D Dataset A large-scale 3D vision-language question-answering dataset for point-grounded, metric-aware 3D scene understanding. Built on ScanNet and ScanNet++ with dense object and part annotations, the dataset spans eight downstream reasoning tasks at both object and part granularity, plus multi-turn dialogue that composes them.
